title: Teen Mental Wellness Online Group
setting: The child joined an anonymous teen support group chat and a member offered to talk one-to-one. The DM begins with check-ins about school stress.

title: Cross-Harbour Tunnel Bus Friend
setting: The child regularly takes the same cross-harbour bus and a fellow commuter from another school follows them. The chat is about the daily route and homework.

title: Kpop Fan Meeting Chaperone
setting: The child is going to a fan meeting with friends and an older fan in the group offers to arrange a shared taxi. The thread is about meeting points.

title: Student Radio Station Host
setting: The child joined a school radio club, and another host chats to share scripts and recording slots. The thread is about the next show.

title: Overseas Cousin Reconnecting
setting: The child's distant cousin living abroad messaged for the first time after finding them on Instagram. The chat is about family and school.
